title: Very Flimsy
text: Very Flimsy. Not what I expected. Bag is very flimsy and will not stand up like shown in the pictures. Waste of money.

product_metadata.title: WONDAY Large Utility Tote Bag, Large Beach Tote,Reusable Grocery Bags Collapsible Tote, Large Tote Bag With Handles Utility Tote Shopping Bags for Beach, Groceries, Storage, Picnic, Pool
features: Extra Large Capacity: This utility tote bag with an extra-large size design: 22" L x 11" W x 13" D , fits up to 18 bottles (1.25 L) , got enough space to carry a lot of daily necessities such as groceries, vegetables, fruits, bottles and jars, shoes and clothes, etc. This large tote bag is reusable for shopping, which will stops from wasting plastic bags.(PLEASE NOTE: Due to collapsible design, there is no wire frame at the top to allow stand upright, BUT there are support panels on both sides.)

Designed for Shopping: This large tote bag is designed for grocery shopping. A movable PP board is designed at the bottom, which will not collapse after placing the items, and will be more stable and firm. Built-in PP panels are designed on two sides to make the structure of the entire shopping bag more stable. The load-bearing capacity of the entire reusable grocery bag is increased, making it more durable for grocery , shopping, luggage, picnics, and storage.

Up to 50lbs Load-bearing: This utility tote is made of thick Oxford-600D PVC coated cationic fabric on the outer layer and nylon on the inner layer. The sturdy and thick water-proof fabric makes it solid and durable. The handle webbing straps go from bottom to top, increase the weight capacity of the bag, making it up to 50 lbs. We also designed a thick handle to provide extra support when carrying the large beach tote, make it easy to carry, and even easier to load them into the trunk.

Foldable Tote Bag: This extra large utility tote bag can be folded up and stored when not in use, without taking up too much space. We also design several small pockets on this reusable shopping bags: inner mesh pocket and front pocket - you can put some small daily items such as cell phones, keys, cards, etc.; and two side mesh pockets - you can put water cups, slippers, etc. No zipper large opening design, spacious space for you to put items quickly and easily.

Multipurpose Grocery Bags: This beach bag tote is available in varies stylish colors. The inside of the grocery bag is large and spacious, perfect for supermarkets, grocery stores, beaches, picnics, pools, water parks, camping, family sports, laundry rooms and other indoor and outdoor settings. If you have any questions about this large reusable shopping bag, please feel free to contact us and we will response within 12 hours.
